summary: Paper: design fixes pushed back into the chat sheets in Paper, so the sheets match what ships. Chat Progress: the dock's Stop layers are SquareRounded (griddy's Stop hard-codes black and check:licensing rejects it), the dock inset is calc(100% - --ui-space-xl × 2) rather than a raw 48px, the thread marks' glyphs are 16px (the root's metrics, as the caption says), the finished action layer is named Button / secondary / md as drawn, the precedence table's quiet dock row is the dock's own box (14px matrix, radius-lg, p-xs), the reasoning fade is --ui-bg-base rather than #FFFFFF, and the dock annotation states the one-moving-row rule. Chat Sources: the focus ring is var(--ui-bg-base) 2px + var(--ui-focus-ring-color) 4px rather than raw hex; the library card glyph is PdfFile as in the list; the folded discs are the first three distinct kinds in list order (Globe, PdfFile, FileText) and the '+3 more' card draws all three hidden kinds; the gathering row draws a held 14px Working Status matrix where the retired ring spinner stood. The preview panels' shadow already equals --ui-shadow-md's light value — Paper has no shadow token type — so it stays. Rich Turn (dark): the Tasks header gains its chevron, the running task loses a hover fill nothing could cause, and the dock and composer Stop glyphs are SquareRounded. The matching needsDesign notes are removed from the chat-run-dock, chat-sources, chat-progress and chat-tasks docs.
